questions.explanation: The question asks you to identify period of trig function in polar. Recall the method: Period = 2π/2 = π. cos(2θ) has period π. The tempting idea is 2π. options.text: They differ by 2π, so they are coterminal

questions.explanation: 11π/4 - 3π/4 = 2π, so coterminal. The tempting idea is they differ by π.
